_comment: Issue #89 Arabic/RTL differential-oracle fixture corpus. word_pdf is PENDING for every entry: no Word 365 available in this environment (see tools/differential/README.md).

justified_simple.docx.description: Two justified (jc=both), RTL-bidi Arabic paragraphs, each wrapping across several lines.

kashida_justified.docx.description: Dense, low-space-ratio justified Arabic paragraphs meant to push the justify pass toward Kashida elongation rather than pure space-stretch.

mixed_direction.docx.description: One RTL-bidi paragraph mixing Arabic prose with embedded Latin words/identifiers and digits (UAX #9 mixed-direction reordering).

rtl_bullet_list.docx.description: RTL (bidi) bulleted list — one abstractNum bullet definition, three list-item paragraphs with numPr.

rtl_numbered_list.docx.description: RTL (bidi) decimal-numbered list with one nested level-1 item, mirroring format-docx's list_bullet_numbered.docx fixture but RTL.

rtl_table.docx.description: A <w:tblPr><w:bidiVisual/> RTL table: 3 columns x 3 rows (header + 2 data rows), every cell paragraph bidi.

long_document.docx.description: 24 justified RTL Arabic paragraphs — a multi-page stress fixture for the page-count and per-paragraph line-break oracle.
